content.text: /ext:medcp In older adults with multimorbidity, which polypharmacy reduction pattern (deprescribing anticholinergics vs sedative-hypnotics) is followed by a lower 90-day fall proportion, and what neurochemical mechanisms could explain it?

I'll leverage the MedCP biomedical knowledge graph to investigate this question, examining polypharmacy patterns, anticholinergic burden, sedative-hypnotic deprescribing, and fall outcomes in older adults with multimorbidity.
